name: Is it better to paint or replace old kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to paint or replace old kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to paint or replace cabinets depends on their current condition and your budget. If your existing cabinet boxes and doors are structurally sound, painting is a cost-effective way to update their appearance and extend their lifespan significantly. Painting can achieve a modern look at a fraction of the cost of new cabinets. However, if your cabinets are severely damaged, have outdated functionality, or if you desire a completely different layout, replacement might be the better long-term solution. We can assess your cabinets and help you make an informed choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting is cost-effective for structurally sound cabinets, while replacement is better for severely damaged or functionally outdated ones. We can help assess your options.
